title: Career Roadmap · Maintenance Electrician
summary: A Maintenance Electrician inspects, tests, troubleshoots and repairs electrical systems, motors, control panels and equipment to keep buildings, factories and facilities operating safely.

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10 → ITI Electrician → Apprenticeship / supervised experience → Maintenance Electrician → Senior Technician / Maintenance Supervisor.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Class 10 is a common entry point for ITI Electrician; check the current trade requirements.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Science, basic electricity and technical drawing.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Circuits, motors, wiring diagrams, electrical testing and workplace safety.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Logical troubleshooting, careful measurement, tool handling and teamwork.

blocks.label: Admissions
blocks.text: Check the latest DGT and state ITI admission notifications.

items.text: ITI Electrician → Electrical installation, equipment maintenance and fault diagnosis.
ITI Electrician – Power Distribution → Electrical distribution systems and related maintenance.
ITI Wireman → Wiring and installation skills; check employer acceptance for maintenance roles.
Diploma in Electrical Engineering → Further technical study and advanced technician pathways.
Apprenticeship → Practical experience under an approved employer and training arrangement.

blocks.text: DGT lists the Electrician CTS as a two-year programme with Class 10 Science and Mathematics or an eligible same-sector vocational subject as the stated entry route.

blocks.text: Check current government-funded vocational training schemes.

blocks.label: Apprenticeship
blocks.text: A stipend may apply under the registered apprenticeship contract.

blocks.text: Depends on the scheme, institution, income, category, domicile and course.
No universal percentage cutoff applies. Verify current official notification.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Electrical fundamentals, wiring, tools, circuit diagrams and safety.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Motors, transformers, control circuits, electrical testing and maintenance.

blocks.label: Apprenticeship
blocks.text: Preventive maintenance, fault diagnosis, equipment inspection and repair under supervision.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Motor-control demonstration; preventive-maintenance checklist; electrical fault-reporting log; energy-use inspection.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: Railways, public-sector undertakings, power utilities and government workshops when vacancies are advertised.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Manufacturing plants, factories, hospitals, hotels, commercial buildings, data centres and facilities-management companies.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Motor maintenance, panel inspection, electrical testing, breakdown response and preventive maintenance.
Find opportunities through Apprenticeship India. Selection depends on vacancies and employer criteria.
Relevant programmes

items.text: Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
Advanced training in industrial electrical maintenance.
Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS), subject to eligibility, for vocational teaching.

blocks.text: Institutions / resources

items.text: National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs), where relevant programmes are available.

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Industrial motors, control panels, preventive maintenance, electrical testing, building services and automation support.

blocks.label: With experience
blocks.text: Senior Technician / Electrical Maintenance Supervisor, subject to employer requirements

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Manufacturing, power, construction, hospitals, hotels, infrastructure, logistics and facilities management.
Technical skills
Tools / technologies

items.text: Electrical hand tools and approved PPE

blocks.text: Useful qualifications

items.text: Apprenticeship completion / National Apprenticeship Certificate, where applicable.
State-specific electrical authorization, where required for the intended work.

blocks.label: Safety rule
blocks.text: Never work on energized equipment without the required authorization, training and approved safety procedures.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Australia, Canada, Germany, UK and New Zealand.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic prerequisites, English or German proficiency where applicable, practical training, apprenticeship or qualification assessment, and local licensing requirements.
An Indian ITI certificate does not automatically authorize independent electrical work abroad. Verify current course availability, entry criteria and local licensing.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Maintenance Electrician, Electrical Technician, Industrial Maintenance Technician, Electrical Installer.

blocks.label: Markets
blocks.text: Australia, Canada, Germany, UK and New Zealand.
Licensing and work authorization vary by country and region. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.

ITI Trainee ↓ Electrical Apprentice ↓ Maintenance Electrician ↓ Senior Electrical Technician ↓ Maintenance Supervisor / Team Lead ↓ Maintenance Manager / Technical Trainer / Contractor, subject to qualifications and authorization.
